title: Matrix conversation adapter
lead: A Matrix bot account that receives commands and sends replies and notifications.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** end-to-end encrypted rooms, unless the interview requires them.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Chat suits quick back-and-forth better than email, and Matrix is FLOSS and self-hostable.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
1. Approve the Matrix client library recorded in ADR 0028 (S61): why the stdlib is not enough, the license and the cost (NF6).
2. Where the sync token is stored: a one-row table in a new numbered migration (recommended; it is backed up with the database), or a file in the data directory?

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Sync loop on the bot account, with the token from `settings.secrets.matrix_token_file` (S65); map Matrix IDs to people.
2. Replies and notifier pings to each person's room.
3. Persist the sync token where Owner input 2 decided.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Tests pass; the owner and one household member exchange commands with larder in Matrix.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
